newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on panic selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on panic selling.

text.p: Panic selling triggered by fears of political unrest pushed Dhaka stocks 2.42 percent down at close of trading on Tuesday, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) was 55.42 points or 2.42 percent down at 2,205.55 on a turnover of 59.3 million taka. Of 80 issues traded, 58 lost and 18 gained.

"Retailers panicked as words spread that the main opposition party might announce a package of anti-government actions," one broker said. Another blamed the slide on losses by blue chips. Singer Bangladesh lost 668 taka to 13,605 and Square Pharma shed 150 to 1,449.
